event: Session handoff and housekeeping only. No guards. Same as a plain plugin install today.
Adds guards against destructive commands, silent shell footguns, and unreviewed or unhygienic commits.
Every guard, including delegation, memory, attention, multi-session and planning rules.

# kind: # Options: stored in user settings.json at pluginConfigs["agent-tiers@<marketplace>"].options, written by
# the plugin dialog, /config and the kit CLI. kit-gate.sh reads them from that file (and managed
# settings files), never from the CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY> env a plugin hook also receives.
# A plain plugin install runs at Core level: every group defaults to false. core has no group option.

timeout: Turns the whole kit on or off, core hooks included. Off keeps it installed; each session start then shows one line saying it is off.
Blocks destructive commands and secrets in written content, bare git add -A and stash, hand-made worktrees; asks or denies agent reach to remote hosts and browser MCPs.

Stops shell commands that fail quietly: recursive grep skipping binary files, pgrep/pkill -f, and long checks piped into tail or polled in a loop; and machine-wide searches or archive loops that compete with you for the machine.

Asks before a commit or push with no independent review, flags commit hygiene problems and private text in a commit, denies undisclosed sed -i or tee writes to tracked files, and logs derived numbers.

Guards sub-agent spawns (model, framing, return-while-running), bare codex calls, and a sub-agent editing its own definition; a Stop send-back for numbered OOS items a sub-agent handed back with no disposition line.
Gates new memory writes behind a coverage check, lints memory content, warns on unopenable path citations, and records what a session authored.

Desktop notifications, plus a Stop block that ends every reply with an operator-tag line, a Stop send-back for a handed-back `!` command with no operator:run tag, ask-gate for questions, and advisory-ack and unattended-mode guards.

Asks before a write into a repo another live session is using, or outside this session's repo. Also simple-rules-guard: no codex resume --last, no sudo JDK switch, no main branch in your own repos, marked defaults, SendMessage rules.

Asks a plan to declare any tracked source file it names but never read, nudges to save approved plans, blocks CSS demo hacks, and blocks manual /compact before the handoff (needs authorship-record, Memory group).
Hook ids to turn off one by one, whatever their group says. Set with: agent-tiers configure --set disabled_hooks=<id>,<id> (or settings.json pluginConfigs).

group: action (settings = the CLI proposes a settings.json change, undone by remove; pointer = printed only)

matcher: Main and sub-agent status rows: folder, model, git branch, context use, session time. Runs the kit's scripts/statusline.sh and scripts/statusline-subagent.sh.

Not installed by this CLI. Install the binary yourself (https://github.com/kenn-io/agentsview), then run: claude mcp add --scope user agentsview -- agentsview mcp. Its semantic search needs an index: run agentsview embeddings build, or schedule it yourself (for example a systemd user timer).
